macros.name: address
macros.doc: Address of the sending unit (or faculty).

macros.name: affiliation
macros.doc: The affiliation tag allows to specify the affiliation of the author.

macros.name: bamadegree
macros.doc: This allows to specify the official degree through an abbreviation.

macros.name: bamadoctype
macros.doc: This allows to set the nature of the thesis.

macros.name: defensedate
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@defensedate tags that later will be used on the title page.

macros.name: defenselocation
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@defenselocation tags that later will be used on the title page.

macros.name: degree
macros.doc: This is the official degree name (in the appropriate language, possibly mixed “dutch (english)”).

macros.name: department
macros.doc: The department sets the department’s name tag \@department that is used in the title page information.

macros.name: doi
macros.doc: Specify the correct doi URL you obtained for your document.

macros.name: embargofull
macros.doc: This macro causes the full embargo message to be printed in colofon of your thesis.

macros.name: embargotemp
macros.doc: This macro causes the temporary embargo message to be printed in colofon of your thesis using the first argument of the macro as start date and the second argument as the end date.

macros.name: jurychair
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@jurychair tag that later will be used on the data page.

macros.name: jurymember
macros.doc: This macro allows for the registration of jury members and their affiliation.

macros.name: subtitel
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@subtitel tag that later will be used on the Dutch translation of the title page.

macros.name: subtitle
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@subtitle tag that later will be used on the title page, in the header/footer and to set the appropriate hyperref tag (if it is loaded).

macros.name: subtitle
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@subtitle tag that later will be used on the title page, in the header/footer and to set the appropriate hyperref tag (if it is loaded).

macros.name: supervisor
macros.doc: Specifies the person(s) that promote(s)/supervise(s) the thesis.

macros.name: titel
macros.doc: This macro sets the \@titel tag that later will be used on the Dutch translation of the title page.

macros.name: titlepageimage
macros.doc: This sets the filename of the central image on the title page to appear clipped within the curves.
